notes.title: Artbook DLC now available!
notes.content:
Hi again! Yesterday I uploaded a new DLC for [i]PRISM[/i]: an artbook I had been working on alongside the game itself.

This artbook has 40+ pages of content, including my detailed notes on character designs; backgrounds; scrapped characters, and concepts; and my original notes for certain scenes in the game. This DLC can be found  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2102370/P_R_I_S_M__A_Visual_Novel_Artbook/]HERE[/url]!

I have also published a bundle of the game and the artbook, which can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27382/P_R_I_S_M__A_Visual_Novel__Artbook/]HERE[/url].

(Please note: The artbook treats the reader as someone who has seen all the endings in the game itself as it, naturally, contains spoilers for [i]P R I S M - A Visual Novel[/i].)

notes.title: Achievement Fix and Edits
notes.content: Fixes have been made to ensure the achievement 'Wizard and Witches' works properly, as well as a minor edit text-wise to a scene in the game itself.
